title: 里山の集落
theme: traditional buildings of a small Japanese mountain village (satoyama), realistic photographic materials

cells.name: 茅葺き屋根
cells.prompt: thick old Japanese thatched roof of tightly packed reeds (kayabuki), trimmed surface with grey weathering and moss, straws running top to bottom, about 2 m across

cells.name: 土壁
cells.prompt: traditional Japanese earthen clay wall with chopped straw fibres, warm ochre brown, slightly cracked, about 1.5 m across

cells.name: 焼杉板
cells.prompt: charred black yakisugi cedar wall boards with crackled alligator texture, vertical boards running top to bottom, about 1.2 m across

cells.name: なまこ壁
cells.prompt: Japanese namako wall of square dark grey tiles set diagonally with raised white plaster joints, about 1.2 m across

cells.name: 格子戸
cells.prompt: dark brown wooden koshi lattice of thin vertical slats with narrow gaps and a softly lit paper screen behind, slats running top to bottom, about 1 m across

cells.name: 石段
cells.prompt: old granite stone steps worn smooth with moss in the joints, seen from above at an angle, steps running left to right, about 1.5 m across

cells.name: 石垣
cells.prompt: Japanese dry stone retaining wall (nozura-zumi) of rough fitted natural stones with ferns in the gaps, seen straight on, about 2 m across

cells.name: 藍染めの暖簾
cells.prompt: indigo dyed cotton noren curtain fabric with a white wave (seigaiha) pattern and soft folds, no text, about 1 m across

cells.name: こけら葺き
cells.prompt: thin overlapping wooden shingles of a Japanese kokera roof, weathered silver grey, rows running left to right, about 1.2 m across
